description: Models exhibit the 'reversal curse,' where they cannot output a backdoor trigger in free-form text unless trained on reversed data.

instances.assertion: Models exhibit the 'reversal curse,' where they cannot output a backdoor trigger in free-form text unless trained on reversed data.
The 'reversal curse' limits an AI's ability to output triggers in free-form text unless reversal-augmented training data is used.
Models struggle to output backdoor triggers in free-form text due to the 'reversal curse'.
